_meta.why_14d: The box has 74.7 GB of disk and was at 79% on 2026-09-02, approaching Elasticsearch's 85% low watermark. Nothing here is an audit trail - logs are for debugging the last few days, and Prometheus keeps 90 days of metrics for anything longer.
_meta.why_rollover_too: max_age alone leaves a single bad day unbounded. A burst of stack traces from one crash-looping container can outgrow the disk before the delete phase ever runs.
